document_specs.description: Selectors to retrieve. Each item is exactly one of document_id or url.

document_id.description: Indexed Glean store ID. For Gmail or Outlook caller-specific citation IDs, try a URL selector instead.

url.description: Document URL to resolve. An empty or malformed URL is not a schema 400. The batch response reports it as a warning after a complete read.

include.description: Optional field groups applied to every document in results. CONTENT adds content to every found document. Each value only adds fields; it does not change which documents are returned.

x-enumDescriptions.CONTENT: Add content, the document's extracted text.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CONTENT: Add content, the document's extracted text.
